metadata.source: Human labels from native data/Subset 1 and data/Subset 2 workbooks, one lesson or lesson portion per file.
metadata.unit: move count per 100 valid nonblank human-labeled teacher sentences within each lesson
metadata.aggregation: Unweighted distribution across eligible lessons; all seven valid teacher classes in denominator.
metadata.teacher_selection: Student Tag native codes 1–5 take precedence. Otherwise use Teacher Tag codes 1,2,3,4,5,8,9, irrespective of Speaker value. Exclude blank sentences, missing tags, Context7, and undocumented codes6/128.
limitations: Benchmark native workbooks and official model TSVs have distinct extraction histories and need not yield identical totals.
All eligible native lessons are used; the illustrative 504 count is not forced.
Descriptive K-12 mathematics reference rates are not causal targets or college teaching-quality scores.
